# Assessment Overview

This document serves as the navigation entry point for the supplementary assessment documents generated for the PhotoAlbum-Java application. Each document provides a focused analysis of a specific aspect of the application.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer visualization of the application architecture: high-level application structure and detailed component relationships. |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external dependencies grouped by functional category, including version and compatibility risk analysis. |
| [API & Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Documentation of all API endpoints, service communication patterns, DTOs, and security posture. |
| [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) | Entity models, database configuration, repository interfaces, caching strategy, and data ownership boundaries. |
| [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, externalized properties, secrets workflow, and framework versions. |
| [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Documentation of core business processes, domain entities, business rules, and decision logic. |
